from pathlib import Path

from svg_preview import read_svg,render_svg,isolate
work=Path(${JSON.stringify(w)})
a,size=read_svg(work/'input-groups.svg')
b,size2=read_svg(work/'candidate.svg')
assert a.attrib==b.attrib and size==size2
old={n.get('id'):n for n in a.iter() if n.get('id')}
new={n.get('id'):n for n in b.iter() if n.get('id')}
assert set(new)-set(old)=={'skirt_back'}
assert not set(old)-set(new)
unchanged=[]
for identity,e in old.items():
 original=copy.deepcopy(e)
 updated=copy.deepcopy(new[identity])
 if identity=='skirt_front':
  for n in list(updated):
   if n.tag.endswith('}desc'):updated.remove(n)
 assert ET.tostring(original)==ET.tostring(updated), identity+' changed unexpectedly'
 unchanged.append(identity)
rear=new['skirt_back']
assert rear.get('data-part-path')=='skirt/skirt_back'
path=rear.find('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}path')
assert path.get('fill')=='#a18bd0' and path.get('stroke')=='none' and path.get('d').strip().endswith('Z')
assert list(b).index(rear)<list(b).index(new['right_thigh'])<list(b).index(new['skirt_front'])
assert list(b).index(rear)<list(b).index(new['left_thigh'])<list(b).index(new['skirt_front'])
def render(root):
 return Image.open(io.BytesIO(render_svg(ET.tostring(root,encoding='utf-8')))).convert('RGBA')
im_a,im_b=render(a),render(b)
diff=ImageChops.difference(im_a,im_b)
changed=ImageChops.lighter(ImageChops.lighter(diff.getchannel('R'),diff.getchannel('G')),ImageChops.lighter(diff.getchannel('B'),diff.getchannel('A')))
assert changed.getbbox() is None,'Resting composite changed'
manifest=json.loads((work/'input-sha256.json').read_text())
for file,digest in manifest.items():
 assert hashlib.sha256(Path(file).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,file+' no longer matches input'
back=copy.deepcopy(b)
isolate(back,'skirt_back')
back_bbox=render(back).getchannel('A').getbbox()
bounds=json.loads((work.parent/'轮廓检查.json').read_text())
assert bounds['status']=='pass' and all(n['outside_samples']==0 for n in bounds['results'])
report={
 'status':'pass','worker':'group_motion_completion','node':'part_motion_completion','group_path':'skirt',
 'canvas':list(size),'existing_geometry_unchanged':unchanged,'static_composite_changed_pixels':0,

}
(work.parent/'自检.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
